purpose: User-reported real-machine and enterprise matrix results for M4. This file is the ONLY input channel for the nine real-world flags in the M4 readiness evidence. Automation must never write a 'verified' status here; it records what the user observed on their own machine.

boundCandidate.note: Results only count while these hashes match the candidate the readiness gate measures. Rebuild the candidate and every status below is discarded until re-observed.

statusVocabulary.verified: Executed on a real machine against the bound candidate and passed. The ONLY status that counts.
statusVocabulary.failed: Executed and did not pass. Records the failure; never counts as verified.
statusVocabulary.skipped_environment_unavailable: The environment cannot run this matrix. Recorded for audit; does NOT count as verified and does NOT complete M4. Formally removing an item from scope requires editing the goal file, which only the user may do.

RealCredentialManagerVerified.note: Code-blocked, not environment-blocked: Host.2016 exposes no credential configuration surface, so credential mode is always Disabled and matrix A cannot be executed. Needs that surface before the runbook applies.
